notes: The San Francisco Planning Commission's minutes of its meetings of 2002, from volume 52 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (52minutesofsanfran2002san, labelled 2002). Action minutes, as in 1994 - 2000: each calendar item prints its case number and planner, the property with its assessor's block and lot, the request, the speakers by name, and the action with the vote list and the motion or resolution number. This batch was read by an external reader (Meta Muse, working from the Internet Archive's one-file djvu text, which has no page breaks) from a written spec, and converted here: every entry's page was located mechanically in the hOCR page split by its case number, its meeting date and its verbatim quote. Pages were dated from each meeting's cover page ('Meeting Minutes' with the meeting date), not from the running headers, which in these volumes often print the wrong date (the 6 February 2003 meeting's pages carry 'January 23'; OCR turns 2001 into 2000, 1001 or 7000) and sometimes quote a continuance date. Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index (first two fields are the text offsets), counting the viewer page among the leaves scandata.xml does not mark addToAccessFormats=false. Four kinds of finding: what the Commission (or, reported in the minutes, the Board of Supervisors or Board of Permit Appeals) decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; what the calendar states stood on or occupied the property; landmark actions; and a dated past fact the calendar prints. A continuance, a motion of intent, a failed motion and an item under 'Items to be continued' are not decisions. The minutes name applicants, owners, neighbours, objectors, commissioners and staff in every item; none of them is in any published field, and every sentence of the reader's notes naming a commissioner was removed on ingest (141 notes). Seventeen descriptions that named only the action were rewritten from the request on the cited page.

coverage.remaining: Every meeting of volume 52 was read: 26 meeting days, 10 January to 27 June and 5 to 19 December 2002. The volume binds no minutes of July to November 2002 (its pages run straight from 27 June to 5 December); those meetings are in no volume of this deposit. Next: volume 53 (January - June 2003).
coverage.note: 361 OCR pages with text out of 398 viewer pages, read by one external reader and converted and located in this session.
